item.title: Agent Skills Deep Dive
item.description:
An agent skill is a reusable package of instructions, knowledge, resources, and tools that teaches an AI agent how to perform a specific kind of work. Here is the shape of the workshop, and the seven ideas it is built around.

If you use an AI assistant for real work, every conversation starts from zero. You re-explain your brand voice, your research process, your review checklist, the format your team expects. The answer comes back good enough, the window closes, and the knowledge goes with it.

item.title: Prototype Driven Development: Keep Your Plan Flexible as You Build with AI
item.description:
Prototype Driven Development is a way of building with AI where you keep your plan but hold it loosely. When you hit a decision you can’t make on paper, you spin off a fast, throwaway prototype to settle it, then fold the answer back into the plan. Here is the shape of the workshop, and the seven ideas it is built around.

Most of us were taught to plan everything up front. Write the document, think it all through, get it right on paper, then build exactly what it says. The plan becomes a contract, and changing it feels like failing.
